title_en: Oni Press' Spirit of the Shadows Is One of 2026's Must-Read Comics, and We've Got the Entire First Issue for Free
summary_en: Oni Press' Spirit of the Shadows is easily one of the most visually stunning new comics of 2026, and now you can read the entire first issue for free.
body_en:
Late last year, IGN debuted a preview of Spirit of the Shadows , a visually stunning horror series from Oni Press. That very psychedelic comic turned out to be one of the real joys of 2026, and now it's available in bookstores as a trade paperback collected edition.
With that in mind, IGN is now able to feature the entire first issue of Spirit of the Shadows. Check it out in the slideshow gallery below and decide for yourself if this is a comic for you:
Spirit of the Shadows is a collaboration between Nick Cagnetti and Daniel Ziegler. Here's the official summary of the book:
“I guarantee you're not going to find another comic on the stands right now quite like this one—from the story to the art, my friend Daniel and I really tried to create something cohesive and evocative in the way that only this medium can provide,” said Cagnetti in his original statement. “To achieve that, I put a lot of care into differentiating styles and techniques for each of the settings the story goes to make them each feel distinct. You're swept up in this dreamlike haze alongside the main character, and you go through all the emotions and revelations alongside him. The end result should really make for a rewarding experience you can reread and look at completely differently the next time, but I'm envious for readers to experience that ride for the first time here soon!”
The trade paperback for Spirit of the Shadows is available in bookstores now. You can order a copy on Amazon .
For more, check out an exclusive preview of The Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost Mine and a preview of the Image Comics graphic novel Content .
Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .
